ul.li: Halal Meals as Specified in Itinerary (7x Dinner)
Entrance Fees: Maori Village (Entrance & Haka Performance)
Return Domestic Flight Tickets (AKL - CHC, ZQN - AKL)

Optional Activity / Entrance Fees: Milford Sound, Hobbiton Movie Set, Christchurch Tram Ride, Kawarau Bungy Jumping, Kawarau Zipride, Queenstown Gondola, Queenstown Luges, Putaruru Blue Spring, The Chasm

div.div: Quality Suites Huka Falls or similar

ul.li: Land transfer to Taupo (town near the centre of the North Island)
Lake Taupo (largest lake in Australasia, roughly the size of Singapore)
Huka Falls (powerful waterfall draining into Lake Taupo, among the highest-flowing waterfalls in the world)
The Redwoods (forest of giant Californian Coastal Redwood trees)
Whakarewarewa Village (living Maori village using natural geothermal resources to cook, bathe, and heat homes)
Optional: Hobbiton Movie Set Tour (guided tour of the Lord of the Rings/The Hobbit filming location) OR Putaruru Blue Spring (crystal-clear turquoise waters, viewed along Te Waihou Walkway)
Land transfer from Hamilton to Auckland
Domestic flight from Auckland to Christchurch
Masjid Al Noor (the first mosque targeted during the Christchurch mosque shootings in March 2019)
Christchurch City (the vibrant, largest city in the South Island)
Optional: Tram Ride (all-day, unlimited hop-on/hop-off ride covering 18 stops — the full loop takes about 50 minutes; Summer season only)
Land transfer from Christchurch to Twizel
Lake Tekapo (picturesque lake known for its turquoise waters and majestic mountain surroundings)
Lake Pukaki (turquoise water with breathtaking views of Mount Cook)
High Country Salmon Farm (premium glacial mountain salmon)
Hooker Valley / Mount Cook (the most popular short walking track within Aoraki/Mount Cook National Park)
Land transfer from Twizel to Te Anau
Lindis Pass (scenic route of rolling hills, snow-capped mountains, and native tussock grasslands)
Roaring Meg (a turbulent stretch of the Kawarau River between Cromwell and Queenstown)

Kawarau Gorge (scenic gorge carved by the Kawarau River, with a historic suspension bridge and popular adventure activities)
Optional: Kawarau Bungy Jumping (the world's first commercial bungy jump, a 43m leap over the Kawarau River)
Optional: Kawarau Zipride (130-metre ziplines at speeds up to 60km/h)
Te Anau (a serene lakeside town and the best overnight base for exploring Fiordland National Park, including Milford Sound and Doubtful Sound)
Te Anau Lake (the largest lake in the South Island, and second-largest in New Zealand and Australasia)
Mirror Lake (a stunning lake reflecting the surrounding Earl mountain ranges on calm days)
Eglinton Valley (a scenic area of golden tussock plains and beech-covered mountains)

Optional: Milford Sound Cruise (a cruise along a fjord renowned for towering Mitre Peak, lush rainforests, and spectacular waterfalls) OR The Chasm (a short 30-minute boardwalk through mossy forest to a stream and waterfall)
Queenstown (the "Adventure Capital of the World", on the shores of Lake Wakatipu)
Lake Wakatipu (New Zealand's longest and third-largest lake, known for its crystal-clear waters and mountain views)

Skyline Gondola (views of Lake Wakatipu, Coronet Peak, Queenstown, and The Remarkables mountain range from Bob's Peak)
Optional: Gondola ride (a scenic 10-minute, 480-metre ascent)
Optional: Luge rides (a 1.6km downhill ride with banked corners, tunnels, and dips)
Domestic flight from Queenstown to Auckland

div.div: Includes: Guided walking tour with access to the movie set, including Hobbit's Hole, Bagshot Row, and the Green Dragon Inn
Excludes: Restaurant/gift shop purchases, personal expenses. Not combined with Putaruru Blue Spring (choose one)
Duration: 2.5 hours - open daily 09:00-17:30. Tickets are limited and can sell out 2-3 months ahead in peak season — request early, as add-ons can't be accepted within 21 days of departure
Includes: Hop-on hop-off pass for a single day, unlimited stops at key locations, commentary from the driver
Excludes: Transportation outside the tram route, personal expenses
Duration: 50-minute full circuit (excluding stops) - open daily 08:30-18:00. Summer season only — not available in Winter.
Includes: The jump experience, safety equipment and briefing, experienced operators, photos and video, an activity t-shirt. Weight limit 35kg-235kg
Excludes: Other activities, cafe/gift shop purchases, personal expenses
Duration: 30 minutes - 1 hour, including briefing and queue - open 09:30-16:00
Includes: The zipride experience, safety equipment and briefing, experienced operators, photos. Weight limit 30kg-150kg; 8-9 y/o ride tandem with an adult
Excludes: Other activities, cafe/gift shop purchases, personal expenses
Duration: 30 minutes - 1 hour, including briefing and queue - open 09:30-16:00
Includes: Two-way gondola rides up to Bob's Peak, access to the indoor and outdoor viewing areas, restaurant, gift shop, and common area
Excludes: Restaurant/gift shop purchases, lunch or dinner package, personal expenses, other activities (e.g. luges, stargazing, mountain bikes)
Includes: Two-way gondola rides up to Bob's Peak, access to the indoor and outdoor viewing areas, restaurant and gift shop, plus 3 luge rides
Excludes: Restaurant/gift shop purchases, lunch or dinner package, personal expenses, other activities (e.g. stargazing, mountain bikes)
Includes: Cruise tour along Milford Sound fjord
Excludes: Restaurant/gift shop purchases, personal expenses. Not combined with The Chasm (choose one)
Includes: Return transfer from Hobbiton to Putaruru Blue Spring
Excludes: Personal expenses. Not combined with Hobbiton Movie Set Tour (choose one)
Duration: Approximately 2.5 hours - open daily, 24 hours
Includes: Return transfer from Milford Sound to The Chasm
Excludes: Personal expenses. Not combined with Milford Sound Cruise (choose one)
Duration: Approximately 1.5 hours - open daily, 24 hours
